existing_group_assignments.rationale: Increased cell proliferation specified for epithelial cells, versus the general and mesothelium-specific forms already in the group.
Increased ductal hyperplasia is the same process as the other increased-hyperplasia events, in a different tissue context.
Increased general DNA damage is the same process as increased DNA strand breaks, which are a more specific form of DNA damage.
Decreased sodium conductance 2 concerns the same sodium channel conductance endpoint as 'Decreased, Sodium conductance 1'.
